source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: CameraActivity captures the images and decodes them with ZXing-C++ (zxingcpp/Mapping.kt), then ContentParser interprets the content. ActionRegistry offers the appropriate action (Wi-Fi, mail, web), the scan is saved in Database.kt, sent by ScanSender.kt and displayed by BarcodeActivity.
